name: rosetta-self-describing-numbers
code:
use default

digit_of(letter: char) -> int => cast int(letter) - cast int('0')

self_describing(value: int) -> bool is
    let digits = "{value}"

    return
        digits
        |> index()
        |> all(digit =>
            digit_of(digit.value) ==
                (digits
                 |> filter(other => digit_of(other) == digit.index)
                 |> count()))
si

for value in [1210, 2020, 21200, 3211000, 42101000, 1211, 2021] do
    write_line("{value} {self_describing(value)}")
od

write_line("")
write_line("self-describing numbers below 100000:")

write_line(
    (1..100000)
    |> filter(self_describing)
    |> map(value => "{value}")
    |> join(" ")
)
